name: Noise Splats
definition: A technique for representing multivariate data sets defined on an integer lattice by extending volume rendering to include nonhomogeneous volume representations. It achieves this by introducing controlled amounts of noise within the volume representation, where varying the local amount of noise represents a separate scalar variable.
summary: Noise Splats is a volume rendering technique that embeds controlled noise into splat textures, using local variance to encode secondary data like material texture or cloud density.
